one_liner: A company context layer for every AI: it watches what matters in each person's AI conversations through MCP, arbitrates what becomes shared truth (sources weighted by role x domain, contradictions clarified then escalated), and serves each person the right context for their role and task.

zetaris.role: governance data over 3 sources (Postgres org chart and trust, finance REST API, S3 drive with procedures) and a Unified Semantic Layer

meterless_engines.role: the company memory: versioned decisions (supersedes), provenance, trust-weighted confidence, CEO policies

nvidia.role: Nemotron models pinned on the three lanes, logged per call

cursor.role: development environment and one of the MCP clients in the demo

domains.admin: personal admin desk (second pack on the same harness)
